title: Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass Wall Mount | Shaded Beige | Que New Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Keep bath towels off the counter and within easy reach with a wall-mounted towel bar designed for everyday use in Shaded Beige, which offers sophisticated warmth in a soft, neutral tone that complements natural materials and earthy palettes.

Highlights:
- Shaded Beige transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Save bathroom space with a wall-mount, straight bar design
- Coordinate your bath with the Que New collection’s distinctive circular detailing and matching Que New accessories
- Fit your style with multiple designer finish options, including statement colors

Specs & Installation:
- Collection: Que New (transitional)
- Product type: Towel bar
- Mounting: Wall mount; concealed screw mounting
- Center-to-center: 30 in
- Dimensions: 30 in L x 33 in W x 3 in H; projection 3 in
- Bar diameter: 0.5 in
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Included: Towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware (#8 x 1 1/4" screws)
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
